Escape to luxury under the African skies.
OLE SERAI LUXURY CAMP TURNER SPRINGS
This particular camp is located 17kms from Seronera HQ / Airstrip, and lies right in the heart of central Serengeti. The spectacular and secluded location of this camp boasts all year round game which choose to graze around the camp due to its lagoon type contoured landscape, where the camps is surrounded on three sides by water catchments. There are also large acacia trees spread sparingly across the camp which adds on to create a tranquil feel of the camp and also helps provide natural shading assisting to keep cool the tents during the hot summer months.

ACTIVITIES & EXCURSIONS
Walking safaris within the camp highlands, game drives, sundowners, aperitifs & cocktails at bonfire place, swahili lessons, story telling, traditional maasai fire lighting, cultural activities, special arrangements for honeymooners and star gazing
DISCOVER MORE
SUNRISE BUSH BREAKFAST
Enjoy a special Bush Breakfast in the bush within the camp ... Read more... a view of the sunrise as you enjoy the Full English Breakfast with your dedicated waiter/waitress taking care of all the other details.
OLE SERAI WAKE UP CALL
Start your day in African style, your room attendant will tip ... Read more... the deck and will gently zip and roll up the window and door canvas flaps, place your coffee at your private deck. You will not resist the great aroma of freshly made hot coffee and the great beautiful morning sunrays streaming to your pillows. Wake up this Oleserai special wakeup call just for you. Free to all our guests just book with your dedicated waiter or attendant.
BALOON SAFARIS
All our camps are strategically located near the balloon safaris points, ... Read more... balloon safaris and enjoy a champagne breakfast deep in the wilderness.
GAME DRIVES
Driving in a custom built safari vehicle with a professional driver ... Read more... you will be real adventurer, searching wildlife and exploring the true African wilderness. The safari vehicle is usually a 4WD vehicle with either slide windows or pop up roof for best panoramic viewing.
MAASAI CULTURAL LESSONS
Immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of traditions, rituals, and timeless ... Read more... down through generations of the Maasai people. This cultural odyssey offers a unique opportunity to explore the vibrant colors of their traditional attire, the rhythmic beats of their ceremonial dances, and the profound significance of their age-old customs.
STORY TELLING AROUND FIRE PLACE
Gather around the crackling flames under the starlit African sky for ... Read more... evening of Storytelling Around the Fireplace at our safari camp. Immerse yourself in the rich tales and traditions of the region, as our skilled storytellers weave narratives that echo through the night. The warm glow of the fire provides the perfect backdrop for an authentic and captivating experience, connecting you to the heart of Africa's storytelling heritage.
SWAHILI LESSONS
Under the open sky, surrounded by the sights and sounds of ... Read more... Swahili Lessons offer a unique blend of cultural exploration and language learning. Led by experienced instructors, you'll uncover the essence of Swahili, a language that reflects the spirit and diversity of East Africa.
BOMA DINNER
Embark on a culinary safari under the African skies at our ... Read more... Experience rich tapestry of flavors as you gather around a traditional open-air enclosure, surrounded by sounds of the wild. Delight in the savory aromas of authentic African cuisine, expertly crafted to tantalize your taste buds. From aromatic grilled meats to vibrant vegetarian delights, our Boma Dinner promises a feast for both the senses and the soul. Share stories and laughter with fellow adventurers while enjoying the warmth of the bonfire, creating memories as vibrant as the starlit African night.
BUSH DINNER
Immerse yourself in the rhythmic sounds of nature as you dine ... Read more... vast, star-studded sky. Surrounded by the untamed beauty of the bush, this unique dining experience captures the essence of safari living. Indulge in a delectable feast prepared by our skilled chefs, blending local flavors and international cuisine. The crackling bonfire and the serenade of nocturnal creatures provide the perfect soundtrack for an unforgettable evening in the heart of the wild.
WALKING SAFARI
Step into the heart of the wilderness and let the untamed ... Read more... nature surround you. Guided by experienced naturalists, this journey on foot offers a unique perspective, allowing you to connect with the environment on a more intimate level. Hear the rustle of leaves, witness the diverse flora and fauna up close, and feel the pulse of the wild. It's not just a walk; it's a sensory exploration, a chance to be part of the untamed rhythm of the safari.
PRIVATE DINNER AT TENT DECK
Experience the magic of an intimate evening under the African sky, ... Read more... the sounds of the wild, indulge in a culinary journey curated just for you. The flickering lanterns and the gentle breeze set the stage for a memorable night as you savor delectable dishes prepared with the finest local ingredients. Whether it's a romantic rendezvous or a celebration with loved ones, the Tent Deck offers a secluded and enchanting set

MIKUMI WILDLIFE LODGE
Nestled in the heart of Mikumi National Park’s scenic Kikoboga area , the lodge offers breathtaking views over the park’s vast plains and a nearby natural watering hole, a favorite gathering spot for elephants, antelopes, and a variety of wildlife. Here, modern comfort meets the untamed beauty of Tanzania’s wilderness, creating the perfect safari escape

LOCATION
Unlike many remote safari destinations, Mikumi National Park is remarkably accessible. The lodge is just a three-hour train ride or a short flight from Dar es Salaam and Zanzibar , making it an ideal choice for both short safari breaks and extended adventures. Whether you’re traveling for leisure, photography, or cultural discovery, Mikumi Wildlife Lodge offers the perfect balance of convenience, comfort, and wilderness immersion.
VIEW LARGER MAP
Accommodation
Mikumi Wildlife Lodge features 48 spacious rooms , each elegantly designed with a blend of African charm and contemporary luxury. All rooms overlook the watering hole and the sweeping savannah plains, offering guests a front-row seat to unforgettable wildlife encounters, often without leaving the comfort of their private balcony or the lodge’s viewing decks.
With world-class amenities , personalized service, and the signature Wellworth Collection hospitality , every stay is crafted to provide a safari experience like no other.

Frequently Asked Questions - Wellworth
Frequently Asked Questions
Preparing for an Adventure
Planning Your Safari
Destinations & Lodges
Safari Experience
Practical Information
Bookings & Support
Corporate Events & Incentives
1. I’m planning my first safari. Where do I start? Start by deciding the kind of experience you want, wildlife adventure, romantic escape, or a mix of safari and beach. Each Wellworth Collection property offers a distinct journey: from the endless plains of the Serengeti to the tranquil beaches of Zanzibar. Our team will guide you through the ideal itinerary, transfers, and accommodation to match your travel style and budget. Simply reach out via our enquiry form or email info@wellworthgroup.com .
2. What types of safaris do you offer? We offer luxury lodge safaris, family safaris, honeymoon escapes, small-group tours, and tailor-made private journeys. Guests can also combine multiple Wellworth lodges for a seamless “Northern Circuit” experience Serengeti, Ngorongoro, and Manyara or connect with the coast for a bush-to-beach adventure.
3. What activities are available during a stay? Depending on your location:
Game drives (morning, afternoon, and full-day safaris)
Bush walks and guided nature trails
Hot-air balloon safaris (Serengeti)
Cultural visits with Maasai communities
Spa, poolside relaxation, and fine dining
Beach activities, diving, and dhow cruises in Zanzibar
4. Where are Wellworth’s lodges located? We operate a collection of lodges, camps, and resorts across Tanzania’s most spectacular locations including Serengeti , Ngorongoro , Lake Manyara , Tarangire , Mikumi , and Zanzibar . Each is strategically placed for easy park access while offering the comfort, cuisine, and warmth of Tanzanian hospitality.
5. Are all lodges open year-round? Most of our properties remain open throughout the year, though seasonal maintenance may apply to selected safari camps. We recommend confirming availability with our reservations team for specific dates.
6. How do I get to your lodges and camps? Our lodges are accessible by scheduled or charter flights from Arusha, Dar es Salaam, or Zanzibar, with airstrips located near each property. Road transfers can also be arranged. We’re happy to coordinate the full journey from your arrival airport to lodge check-in.
7. Can I combine a safari with a beach holiday? Absolutely. Many of our guests finish their safari with a relaxing stay at Zanzibar Beach Resort or one of our coastal retreats. We’ll seamlessly arrange your domestic flight connections.
8. What is the Great Wildebeest Migration? It’s one of the world’s most breathtaking natural spectacles, millions of wildebeest and zebras crossing the Serengeti ecosystem in search of fresh grazing. The movement happens year-round, shifting between the southern and northern plains.
9. When is the best time to see the Migration? The herds are in the southern Serengeti (Ndutu) from December – March , and the northern Serengeti (Kogatende) from July – October . Our Serengeti camps are ideally positioned for both seasons.
10. How does the weather affect a safari? Tanzania enjoys a tropical climate.
Dry Season (June – October): Ideal for wildlife viewing — clear skies, less vegetation, easier sightings.
Green Season (November – May): Lush landscapes, migratory birds, and excellent photography conditions.
All our lodges operate with comfort in mind year-round.
11. What are the visa requirements? Most nationalities can obtain a Tourist Visa online via the Tanzania Immigration website or upon arrival. A passport valid for at least six months is required.
12. What are the vaccination or health requirements? A Yellow Fever vaccination certificate is recommended if arriving from or transiting through infected regions. We also suggest consulting your doctor about malaria prophylaxis and routine travel vaccinations.
13. What should I pack for my safari? Pack light, breathable, neutral-coloured clothing, a wide-brimmed hat, sunscreen, insect repellent, and comfortable walking shoes. Don’t forget a camera, binoculars, and swimwear for our lodge pools and coastal properties.
14. What is included in the price of my stay? Most stays include accommodation, meals, all-inclusive beverages (where applicable), park fees, and laundry. Exclusions typically cover premium beverages, spa treatments, gratuities, and optional activities such as balloon safaris and game drives.
15. Is it safe to travel and go on safari in Tanzania? Yes, Tanzania is one of Africa’s most stable and welcoming destinations. Our lodges follow strict safety standards and trained guides accompany all safari activities.
16. Can I travel with children? Absolutely. All Wellworth Collection properties are family-friendly and can arrange inter-connecting or family rooms, children’s menus, and safe, engaging activities for younger explorers.
17. Do you offer multilingual guides or translators? Yes, on request. English is widely spoken, and we can arrange guides fluent in languages such as French, Spanish, German, or Italian with advance notice.
18. Can I book directly with Wellworth Collection? Yes. You can book directly through our website or contact crm@wellworthgroup.com. We also work closely with trusted travel agents and tour operators worldwide.
19. What payment methods do you accept? We accept major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, Amex) and bank transfers. Rates are quoted in USD or Tanzanian Shillings.
20. How can I contact you for assistance? For reservations or enquiries: 📞 +255 688 058 365 📧 info@wellworthgroup.com You can also reach us through our website form .
21. What corporate services does Wellworth offer?
Wellworth Collection offers a wide range of corporate hospitality solutions including accommodation, conferencing, team-building retreats, meetings, exhibitions, workshops, incentive travel, banquets, and corporate leisure packages across our hotels, lodges, and resorts in Tanzania and Zanzibar.
